question: The Medaram Jatara Festival is a ______ - day long festival celebrated by Koya tribe.
solution:
The correct answer is __**4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Medaram Jatara;-**

 
 
• **It is a tribal festival celebrated in the state of Telangana, India. **
 
• It is held once in two years in the month of Magha (February) on the full moon day.
 
• **It is a 4-day long festival celebrated by Koya tribe.**
 
• **The festival is held in Medaram, a village in the Mulugu district of Telangana. **
 
• Medaram is located in the Eturnagaram Wildlife Sanctuary, a part of Dandakaranya, the largest surviving forest belt in the Deccan.
 
• The festival is dedicated to the goddesses Sammakka and Saralamma, who are worshipped by the Koya tribe, the second-largest tribal community in Telangana.
